ItemID: NA; Title: Unchained Melody; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The title fits my interest in older songs, but I would check the artist before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Janis Joplin's Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I am in the mood for familiar classic rock, and a greatest-hits collection fits my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20th Century Masters: The Millennium Collection - The Best of Lesley Gore; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: This fits the mid-sixties pop mood suggested by my recent AM Gold listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20th Century Masters: The Best of The Commodores - The Millennium Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in sixties pop and folk-rock than a Commodores collection right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Carole King Tapestry; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its melodic songwriting feels like a strong fit with my interest in Simon & Garfunkel and Melanie.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of Fleetwood Mac; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A collection of melodic classic-rock favorites appeals to me after listening to The Cars and classic-rock compilations.
ItemID: NA; Title: See You There; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot tell enough from this title to choose it over the more recognizable options.
ItemID: NA; Title: Magic: The Very Best of Olivia Newton-John; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic pop appeals to me, but I would choose Carole King and Lesley Gore first this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Peter, Paul and Mary; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Their folk harmonies strongly fit my interest in Simon & Garfunkel, Jonathan Edwards, and Melanie.
